revisions.evidence: Kanji Pedia 凌 and 侵 character entries in source-receipt.json; previous complete KANJIDIC2 凌 and JMdict 1554200 and 1618720 records.
revisions.reason: The 凌 character entry positively distinguishes a violation/disrespect branch from endurance/surpassing; 侵's character entry describes entering another's domain and its frozen record includes violation. Avoid broad violation-choice ambiguity in either prompt direction. The displayed title does not itself mean invasion and the branch does not make all senses interchangeable.

revisions.evidence: Kanji Pedia 占 and 侵 character entries in source-receipt.json; previous complete KANJIDIC2 占 and JMdict 1389430, 1389460 and 1389610 records.
revisions.reason: The 占 entry distinguishes divination from occupying or taking possession; the 侵 entry concerns entering another's domain. A territorial situation can blur the broad occupy and invade choices in either prompt direction. Guard conservatively without asserting occupation always involves invasion or inferring constituent senses solely from compounds.

limits: These direct guards prevent bounded broad-choice ambiguity and do not establish universal synonymy, transitive exclusions, exhaustive semantic safety or acceptance by reviewers.
